Network.Technology: 3.9G: FDD-LTE (au VoLTE) (700 MHz/N800 MHz/2 GHz), 3G: W-CDMA (850 MHz/2 GHz), 2G: GSM (1.9 GHz/1.8 GHz/900 MHz)

Body.Dimensions: 146 mm H , 72 mm W , 7.3 mm D

Memory.Card slot: microSD (up to 2 GB), microSDHC (up to 32 GB), microSDXC (up to 200 GB) (officially supported by KDDI)

Display.Display: 5.2-inch TFT Triluminos Display for mobile, FHD (1920 × 1080 pixels), approx. 16.77 million colors

Cameras.Rear camera: Approx. 23 megapixels, backside-illuminated stacked CMOS image sensor (Exmor RS for mobile), Hybrid AF, 4K UHD video recording, image stabilization, Timeshift video, AR effect
Cameras.Front camera: Approx. 5.1 megapixels, CMOS image sensor (Exmor R for mobile), face detection autofocus, 4K UHD video recording, image stabilization, Timeshift video, AR mask
